retro:
# Retrospective

- Independent positive/negative controls and export-value parity made resolution clear without relying on the author's aggregate suite claim.
- Restricting Plymouth coverage to its actual changed Node producer avoided unrelated privileged and transitive mutation surfaces. Opus's broader affected-test run used disposable copies; Astra's separate Node-only run kept corroboration narrow.
- Both reports agreed technically. The stale documentation was kept proportionate, not promoted to a new production finding.
- Herdr managed context and owned Team 1 identities were verified before lifecycle control. Claude Code Opus 5.5 High used existing Claude Max authentication. Fresh native Astra Xhigh and editorial Medium sessions were separately verified.
- No observed safety/process deviation, excluded runtime run, host mutation, desktop allocation or resource blocker. Reviewer metadata paths were initially absent before the first Astra turn saved its session; verification succeeded afterward. No guessed model alias or fallback was used.
- Intake and final fingerprint encodings differ. Keep the explicit final algorithm and equal event-object comparison to avoid confusing an encoding change with new discussion.
- Retain reports, sources, fixtures, raw logs, seals and native session evidence. No remaining owned runtime resources need cleanup. No browser or HTML preview was opened and no upstream action was taken.
comment:
**Verified:** The Node test-interface regression in the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12892#issuecomment-5779336979) is resolved at `2d82b68c`. The test-only loader restores access to the model declarations without restoring CommonJS exports to the QML-facing files.

| Complete test script | Previously reviewed `29ec806a` | Current `2d82b68c` |
|---|---|---|
| `battery-test.sh` | First API call throws `TypeError` | 7 assertions pass |
| `polkit-test.sh` | First API call throws `TypeError` | 8 assertions pass |
| `tray-test.sh` | First API call throws `TypeError` | 9 assertions pass |

**Verified:** The replacement interface exposes the formerly exported declarations across all 26 affected models. All four migrated inline Node producers run successfully, and the menu tests now use the declared `GUARD_READERS` name. The production JavaScript is unchanged since the earlier reviewed revision.

**Documentation correction:** [`docs/testing.md`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/2d82b68cb0798489d9a8c92e60b81e446a1e829f/docs/testing.md#L87-L94) still describes guarded `module.exports` blocks and CommonJS loading. Suggested change: describe the test-only loader and its declaration-name interface instead. This remaining documentation mismatch does not invalidate the test-interface fix.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Node v26.7.0; original/current controls above, all 26 model interfaces, 28 Node-only test blocks and four inline producers. Additional base/original/current runs covered 29 affected shell test files, with the same compositor-gated skip at base and current head. The full Plymouth test, the author's full-suite totals, and the Qt crash fix were not independently verified; no QML runtime test was performed.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Fresh independent Opus 5.5 High and Astra Xhigh technical assessments, followed by Astra synthesis against source and targeted evidence. A separate fresh Astra Medium session checked editorial compliance only.
